evidence.notes: Transitive cesser quelque chose (to stop something) and intransitive la pluie cesse (to cease); cesser de + infinitive is the documented infinitive construction.
Non-pronominal comporter takes a direct object (to comprise/include); the intransitive use belongs to pronominal se comporter, per the usage note.
Takes a direct object in both senses: conclure un accord (reach an agreement) and conclure que… (draw a conclusion).
Direct-object construction per the usage note: confier quelque chose à quelqu'un (to entrust something to someone).
Takes a direct object or a que-clause: constater quelque chose / constater que… (to note, notice).
